title: ED Medication Near-Miss — Heparin Overdose Risk

fields.organization: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center — Emergency Department
fields.location: ED Bay 12, 4 West Patient Care Unit
fields.summary: A 71-year-old patient receiving IV heparin in the ED was transferred to 4 West without documentation of a 5,000-unit dose administered at 05:50. The 4 West nurse administered the scheduled 5,000-unit dose at 06:30 based on the 01:00 paper medication packet. The error was caught when the patient returned to the ED for a CT scan. The lab is sending aPTT results by runner. No clinical instability has been observed.

findings.item: Medication administration documented in EHR
findings.notes: EHR not accessible; documentation relied on paper packet from 01:00

findings.item: Patient transfer between units with medication history
findings.notes: No verbal or written handoff of medication events between ED and 4 West

findings.item: Pharmacist review of high-alert medications
findings.notes: No pharmacist review occurred during transfer

findings.item: Nurse and pharmacist reconciliation of medications
findings.notes: No hourly reconciliation performed as per Downtime Annex, Section 7

findings.item: Laboratory result tracking for anticoagulants
findings.notes: aPTT result pending, runner dispatched

findings.item: Electronic medication administration record (eMAR) status
findings.notes: eMAR frozen; no live access

findings.item: Patient wristband and downtime medical record number (DT-)
findings.notes: Patient has DT-20260303-002

findings.item: Use of downtime viewer BCA-VIEW01 for real-time data
findings.notes: BCA-VIEW01 last refreshed at 05:15; not updated

findings.item: Use of paper tracking board for patient census and status
findings.notes: Board updated at 06:40

findings.item: Staff communication protocol during EHR downtime
findings.notes: No standardized verbal handoff used between ED and 4 West

actionsTaken: Initiated hourly pharmacist and nurse reconciliation of all transfers
Issued transfer sheet for patient, listing all medications administered in the last 12 hours
Requested lab to treat aPTT as stat
Documented error on paper tracking board and flagged for review
recommendations: Implement mandatory hourly pharmacist and nurse reconciliation of all transfers between ED and inpatient units during EHR downtime
Enforce use of transfer sheet with full medication history for all patient moves during EHR downtime
Train all charge nurses on Downtime Annex, Section 7 and Section 5 procedures
Review and validate all paper tracking board entries at top of every hour
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: IMG-20260303-075501 (paper medication packet from 01:00, showing no ED heparin dose)

instructorNote: This inject introduces a high-impact medication error under downtime. Watch for the CNO to initiate the reconciliation process and ensure the HCC is notified. The near-miss must be reported and documented to trigger the incident management chain.
